profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Helmet Security, Inc.

positions.title: VP of Engineering
positions.description:
Led a 12-person engineering org, across all functions, while working hand-in-hand with Product and Senior Leadership. Continued to stay hands-on, personally designing and building the company's cloud infrastructure.

 • Cut monthly cloud costs 72% by deploying Karpenter and moving to spot instances
 • Cut CI build times in half by optimizing pipelines, and trimmed our Datadog bill 40% while building out full-stack monitoring and a real-time status page
 • Migrated our CD pipeline to ArgoCD for declarative, auditable deployments with automated rollbacks
 • Built the collaboration framework connecting Product and Engineering, including goal-tracking, PRDs, and weekly demo/retro cadence
 • Built our on-call rotation and incident response process from scratch, and worked hand-in-hand with Customer Success to keep customer issues documented and prioritized
 • Managed and maintained the end-to-end SOC 2 compliance lifecycle, both Type I & II
positions.insights: Skills: Team Management · Leadership · Microservices · Product Development · Management · Cloud Infrastructure · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · Team Building · SOC 2 · DevOps · Communication · Amazon EKS · Technical Vision · Site Reliability Engineering · Infrastructure · Reliability · Creative Problem Solving · Cloud-Native Applications · Problem Solving · Terraform · Team Leadership · Distributed Systems

positions.title: Head of Engineering
positions.description:
Promoted from Lead Infrastructure Engineer to Head of Engineering, replacing the outgoing CTO. Responsible budget, headcount, and technical direction while we searched for product-market fit.

 • Designed short, iterative delivery cycles built around shipping MVPs for leadership review
 • Simplified our delivery process and built a reporting system to keep leadership aligned on progress
 • Orchestrated the end-to-end SOC 2 compliance lifecycle, resulting in a clean Type I report with zero material exceptions.
 • Optimized the build and release processes

positions.title: Lead Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description: Joined to lead Cloud Infrastructure; promoted to Head of Engineering within 4 months.

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented a Platform leveraging a container orchestration stack using HashiCorp Nomad, Consul, and Vault, replacing manual deployment processes.

 • Automated CI/CD via GitLab CI and role-specific Ansible playbooks, using Ansible + Packer for golden images and Terraform for infrastructure as code
 • Implemented Vault+Consul-based service discovery and secret management, including rotating secrets and audited temporary access requests

positions.description:
Founding engineer building a cybersecurity platform on Kubernetes 1.0 — running production container orchestration years before managed Kubernetes services existed.
